surface_quality.note: Bounded geometric review hints only; absence of reported risk is not visual PASS.

surface_integrity.note: Evidence is intentionally partial because rotated/group-transformed/mesh or invalid geometry is outside this bounded axis-aligned scan. Partial evidence must not be promoted to a clean whole-model surface verdict.

pixel_verification.scope: Full RGBA comparison to final 35-percent texture shading pass

native_coverage_scan.complementary_evidence: full RGBA comparison and embedded PNG equality

visual.comparison: Fresh mapped three-quarter view reviewed for controlled shadow/highlight strength and preservation of aged gold, red cloth and blue-grey steel.

physical_uv_evidence.note: Physical face aspect and texel-density evidence only. Exact UV sharing can be intentional; semantic artwork/material identity and mapped-model visual fidelity still require authoring review.

color_harmony_revision.method: Material-specific reference crops, then stepped ramp adjustment for Blockbench preview values. Existing artwork and mapping retained.

aged_gold_helmet_revision.intent: Darker aged brown gold following latest reference; user-requested imposing helmet embellishments.

blindspot_revision.cause: Dark material bypassed detailed styling, leaving neck/waist/elbow mapped faces base-only.
blindspot_revision.corrected: Neck, waist, elbow faces now have bevels, directed plate seams and stepped wear clusters. Visor kept intentionally dark.
blindspot_revision.gold: Darker brown-ochre ramp, broad highlight bands narrowed and reduced; cloth embroidery uses the same aged gold ramp.

shading_revision.meaning: 35% blend of existing authored pixel color toward bounded material-local shadow/highlight tones, not a Blockbench light or opacity setting.
shading_revision.shadow: Stepped 2-pixel clusters with restrained violet undertone; grouped form shadows and cloth folds.
shading_revision.highlight: Material palette tones capped; aged gold remains brown ochre; no white wash.

spline_issue.fix: interpolation changed from isolated catmullrom to linear
